Author: Ajay Bhanot

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6640 of 2023
Applicant :- Balram

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Pandey,Nandini Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Counter affidavit filed today is taken on record.

By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
243 of 2022 at Police Station-Knowledge Park, District-Gautam Budh Nagar under Sections 419,
420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station-Knowledge Park, District-Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 27.09.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by learned trial court on 09.11.2022.

The following arguments made by Shri Ashish Kumar Pandey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Balram vs State Of U.P. on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13198177/
1
(1). Sim cards were planted on the applicant to implicate him in this case to burnish credentials of the police authorities.
(2). There is no independent witness to the recovery.
(3). The sim cards do not link with any crime.
(4). Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
(5). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(6). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Balram be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 20.2.2023 Vandit  Balram vs State Of U.P. on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13198177/
